lead.headline: Wall Street Rebounds From Bruising Sell-Off as Oil Prices Fall
lead.summary: U.S. stocks opened higher Monday as investors started November in recovery mode after Friday's technology-led sell-off. The week is packed with earnings, labor market data and the midterm elections.

tech.headline: Marvell Reaches $115 Billion Deal for Lumentum Holdings
tech.summary: Marvell Technology agreed to buy data center optics maker Lumentum at an enterprise value of $115 billion, one of the largest tech tie-ups ever. The all-stock deal gives Marvell shareholders 67% of the combined company and is expected to close in the first half of 2028.

sports.headline: Lamar Jackson Hurts Thumb on First Snap as Bills Rout Ravens
sports.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson injured his right thumb on his first snap against Buffalo. He was headed to injured reserve with a potentially season-ending injury. The Bills' defense forced four takeaways, and Cam Ward had his best game of the season.

sports.headline: Cardinals Rally From 17-3 Second-Half Deficit to Stun Cowboys 33-30
sports.summary: Backup quarterback Gardner Minshew II and running back Tyler Allgeier led Arizona back in Dallas. The Cardinals won 33-30.

sports.headline: Commanders Beat Eagles on Sunday Night, Sending Philadelphia to Sixth Straight Loss
sports.summary: Washington closed out Week 8 with a win over Philadelphia on Sunday Night Football. It was the Eagles' sixth consecutive defeat.
